configurations.topology_scope: Validated reciprocal virtual attachments. Potential graph paths do not establish actual packet forwarding or physical separation.

assumptions_and_missing_fields: The host collector enumerates /proc and selects processes by network namespace, including sidecars. It silently skips vanished or unreadable processes; no per-process read-error ledger is exported. Complete observation therefore requires a collector/access/no-relevant-race assumption.

The host process list and namespace associations are direct collector JSON observations, not individual recorded shell readlink commands. Main container identities separately bind to raw Docker observations.

Program names and commands identify recorded sleep and charon programs under an image/runtime correspondence assumption. They are not an executable attestation or a proof against hidden or modified software.
Successful inventory enumeration covers an observation interval. Future process launches, injected execution or configuration changes are not excluded.
The retained public-file inventory does not include complete FRR configuration files or arbitrary charon plugin code. A missing FRR row alone is not used as proof of absence.

Inner forwarding-for-other-encryptors and parallel placement require applying graph/filter semantics to the supplied attachment and raw rule records. Optional management is not required for the selected data-path analysis.

contract: All relevant processes in each namespace were observable during the retained host enumeration. No relevant transient or permission-denied process was silently skipped.
Recorded command/name identities correspond to the ordinary loaded sleep and strongSwan charon programs. Those selected programs provide waiting and IKE/IPsec control, not routing-protocol execution.
No hidden modified executable, unobserved kernel routing-protocol implementation or future launch is represented by this fixed captured process state.
Encryption-terminal forwarding remains permitted under original CP page24 and is not equated with a routing protocol.
